title: ICAI Announces ISA Assessment Test Results on August 3, 2026
content:
# ICAI Announces ISA Assessment Test Results on August 3, 2026

Ek important update hai for all aspiring Information Systems Auditors. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne Information Systems Audit (ISA) Assessment Test ke results announce kiye hain.

Here are the key details:
*   **Examination Held On:** The Information Systems Audit (ISA) Assessment Test was conducted on 25th July 2026.
*   **Results Declared On:** The results were declared in the late evening of 3rd August 2026.
*   **Announcement Date:** This declaration was announced by ICAI on 2nd August 2026.
*   **How to Check Results:** Candidates can access their results by logging into their account at `https://isaat.icai.org/`.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icai.org/category/announcements)

*Published on: 3 August 2026*
